XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine cooling fan relay, 2nd speed (T06)

  • Fault: Air conditioning/heating cabin fan not operating at any speed.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Engine cooling fan relay, 2nd speed, faulty

• Action: Check the condition of the relay and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the relay was found to have overheated pins and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.
    The relay is located in the driver’s side engine compartment fuse box, near the headlight, in position (T06 - (30A).
